ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low ratio; the visible surface is composed of approximately 95% low-intensity (dark) pixels with isolated high-intensity punctate spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation across both lobes; small, localized white pixel blobs are visible in the lower-central region of the left lobe and scattered along the lower boundary of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with steep vertical walls.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern with distinct high-frequency jaggedness along the horizontal span; notable pixel-amplitude variations (valleys) located mid-way between the notch and the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex sweep curves rising from the central notch toward the lateral apexes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular, high-intensity (off-white) pixel groups localized at the extreme lateral tips of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, short-length linear white marks visible on the medial portion of the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of high-contrast textured masses (barnacles) on the lobe tips; minor irregular indentations along the trailing edge boundary.
